predictions.prediction_text: Start to take profit when you see bigger sell orders, profit taking, or decreasing directional volume, or when the price approaches a certain pivot.
predictions.condition: seeing bigger sell orders, profit taking, or decreasing directional volume; or price approaching a certain pivot
predictions.expected_result: Traders will close part of positions and realize gains when those volume signals or pivot proximity occur.

predictions.prediction_text: If the market disproves your position and moves against you, do not accumulate losses; consider closing unless it is a fake-out or breakout.
predictions.expected_result: Traders will exit losing positions promptly unless subsequent price action indicates a fake-out or breakout, reducing further losses.

predictions.prediction_text: Wait for your second target that you planned before taking further action.
predictions.expected_result: Traders will hold positions until the predefined second target is reached before adjusting or closing them.
